name: Dyson style
touchpoints: the product pages' Specifications panel (a light label, a large Light number with a small unit, a hairline, the 'Was' price beside it, claims footnoted * † ‡), the particle count on the cordless vacuum's LCD screen (four sizes in four colours on black, the total on top), the air purifier's screen (a Good, Fair, Poor, Very poor colour bar with an arrow at the level now and a 24-hour graph that takes the level's colour) and the charts Dyson publishes with its air quality studies (black panels, white lines, a red guideline with a red label, a big light figure, lowercase 'fig.' captions)

sample.topic: Test and ship quality at Vizney Appliances, a fictional appliance maker, for its S7 cordless vacuum in week 47 (Nov 16–22, 2026): three assembly lines building the same model, one lot a line each weekday (15 lots, 42,000 units planned), six end-of-line stations (motor run-in, suction, noise, seal, battery and charge, cosmetic) with each station's 4-hour fail rate over the last 24 hours, a weekly filtration audit of 12 units a line (particles a litre in the exhaust at four sizes against an allowance), first-pass yield for weeks 36 to 47 and early returns by cause against last year. A new seal batch went into Line 2 on Wednesday, Nov 18: its seal test fails 2.4–5.3%, big particles pass the seal (2.5 µm at 220% of the allowance, 10 µm at 340%), so its last three lots (6,550 units) are held; Line 3's battery test turned Fair after a new cell lot. Product, lines, stations, specs and numbers are invented; no real product, technology or factory is named

canvas.role: the page: dyson.com is white, and so is everything between the screens (titles, the table, the workbench, terms)

band.role: the spec-sheet band behind the five key figures, running the full width of the window (the Specifications panel and product-list areas on dyson.com, measured)

card.role: tooltips (1px #eeeeee, 4px corners, shadow rgba(0,0,0,.18) 0 2px 10px 2px), the workbench panes and white panels

header.role: the header: business and report name on the first line, line tabs on the second, white text in Light 300 with the selected tab in 500 and a 2px white underline (the dyson.com header, measured)

screen.role: every figure sits on a black screen with square corners and no bezel, glow or rounded display (the product screens and the published chart panels). Titles and captions stay on the white page above and below it

screen-rule.role: dividers between screens and row rules on black; baselines #3a3a3a, level guides #262626

screen-text.role: names, keys, last-week ticks and secondary values on black (10.7:1); ticks #919191 (6.7:1); values and the subject white

ink.role: titles, values and key figures on white (dyson.com text), 12.6:1 on white

body.role: body text, table values and terms, 10.4:1 on white

text-2.role: spec labels, subtitles, keys, captions and the 'Was' line (the dyson.com label grey, 16px 500 in the spec panel), 7.5:1 on white

muted.role: axis labels and table heads on white: Dyson uses one secondary grey, so labels and subtitles share it (7.5:1)

faint.role: code line numbers and other non-essential text only (3.2:1 on white, 6.7:1 on black)

hair.role: the hairline under every spec value, row rules in the table, the KPI band's rules (measured)

line.role: card and workbench borders (1px, 8px corners, the product-list card), button outlines in a light state

link.role: the price blue: focus rings and links only, never data (5.6:1 on white)

accent.role: the deal-button green, UI only: one primary button per screen with black text (8.8:1), 4px corners. Never a data colour

hold.role: the Hold badge (white text 6.1:1, 2px corners, 28px high) and the allowance or target line on a screen; text #b0122f on white, #ff6b7f on black

focus.role: focus ring on white, 2px with a 2px offset; on black the ring is white

validation.tool: dataviz validate_palette.js (OKLab), run 2026-11-23: on the black screen #000000 and on white #ffffff
validation.categorical: magenta #c4307f, blue #2a6dc4 and amber #a87018 pass every check with --pairs all on both surfaces: lightness inside the band, chroma ≥ 0.1, worst CVD pair blue↔magenta ΔE 11.8 (protan), worst normal-vision pair amber↔magenta ΔE 21.1, each ≥ 3:1 on #000000 and on #ffffff. Other is #a3a3a3. On white, amber text steps down to #8a5a10 (5.9:1)
validation.sizes: the four particle sizes, always in this order (smallest first: yellow #f5dc3c, orange #e8641e, pink #de3f9e, violet #8462d8), pass with --pairs all on black: worst CVD pink↔violet ΔE 9.5 (protan), normal vision 18.6, each ≥ 3:1 (violet 4.7:1). Yellow sits above the lightness band (L 0.89) on purpose, as on the product screen; every bar has its size under it and its value above it, so colour is never alone. Black screens only: on white the yellow is 1.4:1
validation.levels: Good #2fae5f, Fair #f5dc3c, Poor #e8641e, Very poor #c0183e pass on black in their order: worst adjacent CVD Very poor↔Poor ΔE 15.1 (deutan), normal vision 16.4, each ≥ 3:1. Good↔Poor is only ΔE 6.9 under deutan, so a level is always the stacked bar's position and the level's name beside the value. Level words on black: #2fae5f 7.3:1, #f5dc3c 15.2:1, #e8641e 6.3:1, #ff6b7f 7.7:1; on white #1d7a43 5.4:1, #8a6d00 4.9:1, #b4490d 5.4:1, #b0122f 7.1:1
validation.status: on black Good #2fae5f and Bad #c0183e: CVD ΔE 13.0, normal vision 35.8. On white #1f9a52 and #c0183e: CVD ΔE 7.1, inside the floor band, so status is always a word (Hold, Release, Within allowance, Over at 2 sizes)
validation.comparison: this year magenta #c4307f against last year #5c5c5c on black: CVD ΔE 6.3 (protan), normal vision 21.4. Legal only with the secondary encoding the split bar gives: this year always left of last year, the value inside every segment and a key
validation.subject: after the published charts: the subject a white 2.5px line, other lines #8c8c8c (6.3:1) 1.5px, the plant total a dashed #b9b9b9 line, the target a red #c0183e 2px line with a red #ff6b7f label
validation.sequential: one violet hue. On white #ad9cee → #41298a, light to dark: monotone lightness, the light end 2.40:1. On black #4d3a9e → #d0c4fa, dim to bright: the dim end 2.41:1
validation.diverging: better is blue, worse is red, with a neutral midpoint. On white blue #2a5fae → #93b5ed, midpoint #e6e6e6, red #ee9ea9 → #a0193d; on black blue #2c5fb0 → #97bcf4, midpoint #3a3a3a, red #9a1a3c → #f3949f. Each arm passes the ordinal checks
validation.text: on white: ink #333333 12.6:1, body #404040 10.4:1, labels #555555 7.5:1, green text #1d7a43 5.4:1, red text #b0122f 7.1:1, link blue #0066cc 5.6:1; on the band #fbfbfb labels 7.2:1. On black: white 21:1, #b9b9b9 10.7:1, ticks #919191 6.7:1, red text #ff6b7f 7.7:1. Black text on the deal green 8.8:1, white on the Hold red 6.1:1

code.note: white like the page, the level text steps for strings, numbers and functions and the price blue for properties; every token ≥ 5.3:1 on white, line numbers excepted

sans.role: everything: Jost stands in for the geometric sans dyson.com uses (SIL OFL); Korean is Noto Sans KR, the face dyson.co.kr sets beside it. Book 400 for text, Medium 500 for labels, titles, tabs and buttons

display.role: Light 300 for the result sentence, section names, the five key figures, the particle totals and every big figure (1.9×), as dyson.com sets its headings and spec values

mono.role: code only; numbers in figures and tables stay in Jost with tabular figures

scale.headline: 31px/300 (ko 27px), line-height 1.25, one sentence
scale.spec-value: 42px/300 with the unit at 23px/400 on the same line, a 1px #dadada hairline under it; the 'Was' line 14.5px/400 #555555 with the change in 500
scale.card-title: 19px/500 (ko 18px), the finding as a sentence; subtitle 14.5px #555555
scale.screen: on black: names 13.5px/500 white, the total 40px/300 with 'particles/L' 12.5px, values above bars 12.5px/500, sizes under bars 12px #b9b9b9, the audit line 11.5px #919191
scale.caption: 13px #555555 under the screen, 'fig. 1.' in 500 ink (ko '그림 1.')
scale.section: 30px/300 with its number in #919191 (01 Ship or hold), a 15px kicker
scale.table: 15px rows 66px high, lot IDs 16px/500, numbers tabular

rows: header, black, two lines: business and report name with the period, EN/KO; then line tabs (All lines, Line 1–3) and the as-of time
the result in one Light sentence on white

the spec-sheet band (#fbfbfb, the full width of the window): five key figures, each label → Light number with a small unit → hairline → 'Was' and the change; the test conditions as * † ‡ footnotes under the band

row 1 (1fr | 560px, equal halves below 1360px), titles, screens and captions aligned by subgrid: Figure 1 particle count (a black screen a line, four size bars against a red allowance line at 100%, the total on top) · Figure 2 station levels (rows of stations, columns of lines; each cell a four-colour level bar with an arrow, the 24-hour trace inside the bar's bands, the value and the level's name)

01 Ship or hold: Table 1 lots, holds first (lot and day, units, first-pass yield with a bar and the 97% target tick, suction, the seal test with a small level bar, a Hold or Release badge); eight rows, then Show all

02 Trend and returns (1fr | 1fr): Figure 3 first-pass yield by week (white subject line, grey lines, a red target line with a red label, an annotation at the change) · Figure 4 early returns by cause (split bars this year | last year with values inside, a dotted no-change line, a big Light figure)
03 Build it yourself: the workbench (files, the figure with and without DASHBOARD.md, the code)
04 How we count: definitions in two columns, then the footer

motion.rise: 1.3s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.3,1): the particle bars rise from the baseline fast, then slow, 70ms apart and 120ms a screen, as the product screen's graph 'rises quickly then slows down'; values fade in after 0.7s
motion.draw: 1s, the yield lines and the 24-hour traces draw in
motion.grow: 0.6s, table and return bars grow from the left
motion.typing: the workbench types its code a line at a time

tableau.fonts: Tableau Book for text; Jost and Noto Sans KR only if installed on every viewing machine and the server. Shade a worksheet black for the screens and set its text white

measured.date: 2026-11-23, the built-in browser (getComputedStyle at 1440×900): dyson.com home, the cordless vacuum list, a cordless vacuum product page with Specifications open, two support guides (the cordless vacuum's LCD particle graph, the air purifier's screen), the published chart page of Dyson's connected air quality study, dyson.co.kr and the terms of use
measured.page: header #000000 (menu 16px Light white), a language strip #242424, a notice strip #0066cc. Text #333333, labels #555555, tertiary #919191, bullets #404040. Hairlines #dadada under spec values, card borders #dcdcdc, sticky cards 1px #eeeeee with 4px corners and a shadow rgba(0,0,0,.1) 0 2px 6px 2px. Panels #fbfbfb. Price blue #0066cc 32px/500, 'Was' 16px #555555. Deal button green #79b928 with black 18px/500 text, 0 or 4px corners. Badges black or blue, white 14px/500, 2px corners, 28–30px high. List cards white, 1px #dcdcdc, 8px corners, titles 18/28 500
measured.spec: Specifications panel #fbfbfb in four columns: label 16/24 500 #555555 → value 36/44 Light 300 #333333 with the unit 24/32 400 on the same line → a 1px #dadada hairline; text values 24/32 400; claims footnoted * ‡ ⁺⁺
measured.screens: the cordless vacuum's LCD counts particles at four sizes in yellow, orange, pink and violet with the total on top, and its graph 'rises quickly … then slows down'; the air purifier's screen has a Good · Fair · Poor · Very poor colour bar (green, yellow, orange, red) with an arrow at the level now and a 12-second or 24-hour graph whose line takes the level's colour
measured.charts: published study charts: black panels, values inside bars in white, a dotted 50% line, a red guideline with its label in red, season labels above, month initials below, a big light '3x' with a two-line sentence beside it, lowercase captions 'fig. 1. …'
measured.type: dyson.com sets a geometric sans (Light 300 for headings and spec values, Book 400, Medium 500); dyson.co.kr sets Noto Sans beside it. Not used: the brand typeface itself; Jost and Noto Sans KR stand in (SIL OFL)
measured.not_used: the Dyson logo and wordmark, the brand typeface, product photos and renders, product shapes (round displays, cyclones, loops), the screen icons, product and technology names, real specifications or test results, factory locations and people
